ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. Charlie Christian. Blanton, They just lived too fast. Charlie Christian, they were young musicians, genius. But, who's we used to say that what they contributed, that they could have contributed more -- Jimmy Blanton died at 22, Charlie Christian died about 24.
And yet they had such an impact in those short --
